description: Add a single primary runtime decision surface to Issue Detail and route runtime transport notices away from inline issue content.

tasks.title: Build the Issue Detail runtime decision surface
tasks.description: Implement a pure deriveRuntimeDecision() helper that maps existing API facts (workflowStage, health, approvalState, recovery, convergence, drift, startEligibility, workflowStageProgress, workflowTimeline, agentStatus) to exactly one summary (running/queued/approval-required/blocked/failed/done), the current task/check, and the context-specific action set. Build the RuntimeDecisionSurface component that renders that output, wire it to the existing approve/reject/retry/resume/rerun/stop/start mutations, and mount it above WorkflowView in IssueDetailPage while demoting the header pills, Actions card, and InlineApproval to supporting detail. Sessions and logs must stay reachable below as evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: deriveRuntimeDecision() returns exactly one of running, queued, approval-required, blocked, failed, or done for representative fixtures covering each state.
A Check stage with a failed health/script verification resolves to 'failed', NOT 'approval required', even when approvalState.status is 'awaiting'.
When no explicit queue/wait signal is present, the helper falls back to running/idle rather than showing a false 'queued' (graceful degradation pending #23).
The surface names the current task/check using recovery.currentWorkItem, then workflowStageProgress.currentTaskTitle, then the first running task/check, then the stage name.
Surface action enablement follows recovery.allowedActions union workflowTimeline.availableActions; actions not present in those projections are disabled.
RuntimeDecisionSurface renders directly above the stage bar; the header pills, workflow step list, Actions card, and InlineApproval remain visible beneath it as supporting detail.
Sessions and logs remain reachable lower on Issue Detail as supporting evidence.
Unit tests for deriveRuntimeDecision() cover all six states, the failed-verification-overrides-approval case, current-task naming fallbacks, and action-availability following the projections.
Component tests render a single 'running' summary and a single 'approval required' summary near the top, each naming the current task/check and exposing the next action.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/model/derive-runtime-decision.ts (+ unit tests), packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/RuntimeDecisionSurface.tsx (+ tests), and the integrated IssueDetailPage.tsx
tasks.notes: Decisions 1-5 of design.md. Keep derivation pure and React-free so precedence rules are unit-testable in isolation. Reuse the mutation hooks already wired in IssueDetailPage; do not duplicate query/mutation setup. Do not delete the legacy Actions card or InlineApproval in this task — demote them. Also satisfies 'Decision surface names the current task or check with its status', 'Decision surface exposes the context-specific next action', 'Sessions and logs are supporting evidence, not primary state', and the web-ui 'Issue Detail routes its primary runtime answer through the decision surface' requirement.

tasks.title: Route runtime transport notices away from inline issue content
tasks.description: Add a minimal hand-rolled toast host (no external dependency) and a useConnectionState(projectId) hook in events-hub.ts that exposes the SignalR HubConnection state (connecting/connected/reconnecting/disconnected). Route connection-disconnect, reconnect, and runner-drop notices to the toast host and/or the existing Activity surface, and audit the live-events to page render path so no transport text is rendered as plain inline content between Description, Commits, Comments, or other issue sections.
acceptanceCriteria: useConnectionState(projectId) exposes connecting, connected, reconnecting, and disconnected states derived from HubConnection.onreconnecting/onreconnected/onclose.
Connection-disconnect, reconnect, and runner-drop notices render as toasts and/or Activity entries, never as plain inline text between issue content sections.
After the audit, Issue Detail content sections (Description, Commits, Comments, and other content regions) contain only issue content for a disconnected-transport fixture.

A component test renders IssueDetailPage over a disconnected-runtime fixture and asserts no transport notice text appears inline between content sections (covers the disconnected-runtime-notice rendering AC).
No new third-party toast dependency is introduced in packages/web/package.json.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/shared/ui/toast/ (toast host), useConnectionState in packages/web/src/shared/api/events-hub.ts, the audited render path, and the disconnected-runtime-notice component test
tasks.notes: Decision 6 of design.md. Constrain the toast host to transport/runner notices only; broader product toasts are out of scope. Depends on T-001 because the disconnected-runtime-notice test runs against the final IssueDetailPage layout that T-001 restructured (surface at top, content sections ordered). Also satisfies the web-ui 'Runtime transport notices do not render as inline issue content' requirement and the disconnected branch of the 'Decision surface has regression test coverage' requirement.
